name: catalogue_concept
description: Write a new concept entry to research/concepts/ or append an amendment to an existing one. Handles file naming (kebab slug), frontmatter blockquote, confidence line, README update, and TOPICS.md status change. Mutating — requires human confirmation before writing.

name.description: Concept name in kebab-case (e.g. 'hermes-agent-skills'). Used as the filename.

title.description: Full human-readable title for the frontmatter blockquote (e.g. 'Hermes Agent — Skills Subsystem').

source.description: Primary source citation for the frontmatter blockquote (e.g. 'GitHub NousResearch/hermes-agent').

relevance.description: One-line relevance statement for the frontmatter blockquote — why this concept matters to the project.

confidence.description: Confidence level with method in parentheses (e.g. 'High (source code + README)', 'Medium (docs + WebSearch)').

content.description: Full markdown body of the concept entry — sections, tables, code blocks. Do not include the frontmatter blockquote or confidence line; those are generated from the other fields.

sources.description: Source URLs or file references, each with '— fetched YYYY-MM-DD' suffix. Added to the Sources section.

applied_in.description: Relative paths to report files that apply this concept (for bidirectional linking). Optional.

amend.description: If true, append an Amendment section to an existing file instead of creating a new one. Requires the file to already exist.

amendment_reason.description: Required when amend=true. Brief reason for the amendment (e.g. 'OpenClaw clarified').

examples.description: Create a new concept entry for a freshly researched tool
